critic_risk_flags: Fractional memory adds flexibility that is hard to justify with only 31 training points and moderate peakiness; it increases overfitting risk and can create identifiability issues (fractional order confounding with transmission/waning timescales). Given the stated risk, fractional dynamics are not clearly warranted here compared with non-fractional delayed_I options.

I+H observation map is less well-aligned to a hospitalization-rate target (admissions) and introduces additional confounding between infectious prevalence and hospitalization dynamics. With short single-season data, mixing I and H can reduce identifiability and blur peak timing without a clear semantic justification beyond robustness.
